mapper.select: SELECT u.dept_id AS department_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.principal_type, COALESCE(( SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(r.role_code) AS CHAR) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ), '[]') AS roles FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_oper_log(user_id, actor_dept_id, actor_username, module_name, business_type, action, success, changes, trace_id, request_method, request_route, http_status, error_code) VALUES (#{event.actorId}, #{departmentId}, #{username}, '请求安全', 'OTHER', IF(#{event.status} >= 500, 'http:FAILURE', 'http:REJECT'), FALSE, '{}', #{event.traceId}, #{event.method}, #{event.route}, #{event.status}, #{event.errorCode})

INSERT INTO sys_oper_log(user_id, module_name, business_type, action, object_id, success, changes, trace_id, actor_dept_id, actor_username) VALUES (#{userId}, #{module}, #{businessType}, #{action}, #{objectId}, #{success}, #{changes}, #{traceId}, #{departmentId}, #{username})

INSERT INTO sys_oper_log(user_id, action, object_id, success, changes, trace_id, actor_dept_id, actor_username) VALUES (#{userId}, #{action}, #{objectId}, #{success}, #{changes}, #{traceId}, #{departmentId}, #{username})
